configurations.name: obsidian-arc-plugins-demo
runtimeArgs: D=$(mktemp -d) && PW=$(openssl rand -hex 8) && echo "demo admin: admin / $PW" && go run ./cmd/arcpack build sdk/examples/demo -o $D/demo-1.0.0.arcx && OBSIDIAN_DATA_DIR=$D/data OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR=$D OBSIDIAN_ADDR=127.0.0.1:18088 OBSIDIAN_COOKIE_SECURE=false OBSIDIAN_ADMIN_USER=admin OBSIDIAN_ADMIN_PASSWORD=$PW OBSIDIAN_DEV=0 exec go run ./cmd/server
